evidence.dominant_driver: Goldman pulled its next Fed hike forecast forward to October after interpreting the FOMC as more hawkish than expected; this reinforces but does not originate the post-FOMC tightening repricing.

market_expectations.expected_value: another 25bp hike by year-end; October not fully priced
market_expectations.distribution_notes: Reuters reported about a 50% probability of another hike next month and about 90% by year-end.

absorption.reason: The core hawkish Fed information was already known for hours; Goldman's forecast change is only ~23 minutes old but market pricing had already moved toward another hike.

observations.DXY: strong at a seven-week high area
observations.gold: rebounding to about 4295 despite hawkish backdrop

evidence.decision_notes: Residual forecast from actual decision time.
